The challengeOnboardingSong dedicationPodcast participationTesting & iterationReflection

Less effort before listening. More connection while listening.

The team explored two barriers: demanding onboarding and limited opportunities for listeners to participate.

A heuristic evaluation, five interviews, and analysis of 500+ reviews focused the work on onboarding, navigation, and social connection.

1. Make the first steps easier to follow.

We explored clearer questions and fewer unnecessary steps. The recorded journey moves from account confirmation through location and genre preferences.

Watch the onboarding recording ↗ (opens video in a new tab)

2. Give a song a personal meaning.

Listeners can enter from the player, choose a song, add a personal message, and submit a dedication.

Watch the dedication recording ↗ (opens video in a new tab)

3. Turn listening into a conversation.

Episode-level polls and comments give listeners a way to respond alongside the audio.

Watch the podcast recording ↗ (opens video in a new tab)

Make settings discoverable and actions explicit.

Testing exposed hidden location controls and unclear playback actions. The revisions surface location in the profile and add explicit Played feedback.

Location selection

Playback feedback

These are prototype findings and iterations; measured retention impact is not established.

Clarity before more features.

Privacy and moderation capacity limited social concepts; advertising remained a business constraint. Next, I would test core-action comprehension before expanding participation features.
